fieldValues.title: Essays cannot show an image
fieldValues.statement: An essay writer cannot put an image in an essay, so an argument that needs a picture, chart or diagram is handicapped. The essay offers only text paragraphs. A markdown image typed into a paragraph does display, but only from a remote URL: the image is not stored with the essay, can break or track its readers, and the visual editor treats such a paragraph as source. There is no supported way to add an image the essay owns, lay it out, or caption it.
source_ref: srs-programme: decision c7d81c5d (no images in the visual editor for now; revisit when writers ask for images)
srs-rust: crates/srs-core/src/markdown.rs (render_markdown renders http(s) and relative image URLs)
